title: Operating-Point vs Capability: A Preregistered Reproducible Negative Study of Inference-Time Mechanisms (+ Lean-verified lemma corpus)
description: 90-experiment preregistered study: inference-time mechanisms shift the evaluation operating point (selection/abstention/verification/search), not underlying capability; reproduced across 3 open-weight model families; 10 machine-checked (Lean 4, kernel-verified, no sorry) elementary lemmas incl. a scoped Collatz-local descent lemma; full negative-results record + reproducible package. No novel theorem or solved open problem claimed.
